description: Domain registration facts via RDAP (IANA bootstrap, then the registry's own server): registration, last change and expiry dates, days left, registrar name, status flags, nameservers and DNSSEC delegation flag. Registrant contact data is usually redacted by registries and is not returned. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_whois_rdap
title: Domain registration facts via RDAP: registration, last
